title: Advanced CloudFormation
description: Master advanced CloudFormation features like nested stacks, StackSets, drift detection, and change sets.

data.text: AWS CloudFormation lets you define infrastructure as code using JSON or YAML templates. Advanced features like **nested stacks**, **StackSets**, **drift detection**, and **change sets** help you manage complex environments at scale.

Nested stacks let you reuse common patterns. Instead of copying and pasting the same VPC or security group template, you create a separate template and reference it from your main stack. This keeps your code DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself).

data.title: Nested Stack Reference in a Parent Template (YAML)
data.content: This YAML snippet shows a parent stack referencing a nested stack template.
data.code:
Resources:
  VpcStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/my-bucket/vpc-template.yaml
      Parameters:
        VpcCidr: 10.0.0.0/16
        Environment: production

  AppStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    DependsOn: VpcStack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/my-bucket/app-template.yaml
      Parameters:
        VpcId:
          Fn::GetAtt:
            - VpcStack
            - Outputs.VpcId

data.title: CloudFormation Advanced Features
items: **StackSets** — deploy the same stack across multiple AWS accounts and regions
**Drift detection** — find resources that have changed outside of CloudFormation
**Change sets** — preview what CloudFormation will do before applying changes
**Custom resources** — invoke Lambda to handle resources CloudFormation does not natively support

data.title: Best Practice
data.text: Use change sets in production. They let you review the exact changes CloudFormation will make before anything is modified.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Nested stacks help you reuse and organize infrastructure code
StackSets deploy stacks across multiple accounts and regions
Drift detection identifies manual changes outside CloudFormation
Change sets provide a safety preview before updates
